disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部源码与构建产物的敏感信息面：未发现读取宿主凭据文件、密钥/令牌/助记词等硬编码或枚举模式；源码中出现的 token 一词仅为样式变量注释，非凭据。命中 0。
checked_items.en: Inspected the sensitive information surface of all source code and build artifacts: no reading of host credential files, hardcoded or enumerative patterns for secrets/tokens/mnemonic phrases found; the token term appearing in the source is only a style variable comment, not a credential. Hit 0.

checked_items.zh: 核查了分享流程的数据流：仅读取页面中的对话节点用于导出图片或 Markdown，没有任何读取用户私密文件、云凭据或钱包资产的调用。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the data flow of the share process: only reads dialog nodes in the page to export images or Markdown, with no calls that read user private files, cloud credentials, or wallet assets.

evidence.zh: 插件未读取任何凭据或敏感文件路径（全树无凭据读取类调用），同时无主动外发通道，不存在凭据外泄链路。
evidence.en: The plugin does not read any credentials or sensitive file paths (no credential-reading calls anywhere in the tree), and has no active outbound channel, so no credential exfiltration path exists.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部面向模型的文本面（工具描述、系统提示、说明文档、协作约定文件）：插件未注册任何工具、未注入系统提示片段，无指令覆写、无远程指令加载、无审批绕过措辞。命中 0。
checked_items.en: Inspected all model-facing text surfaces (tool descriptions, system prompts, documentation, collaboration convention files): the plugin registers no tools, injects no system prompt fragments, has no instruction override, no remote instruction loading, and no approval-bypass wording. Hit 0.

checked_items.zh: 机械预扫命中的模型面指令文件（规则 DSH-X10）经人工通读确认：内容仅为仓库协作约定与发版规则，无任何注入内容，判定良性排除。
checked_items.en: The model-surface instruction file hit by mechanical pre-scan (rule DSH-X10) was manually read and confirmed: the content is only repository collaboration conventions and release rules, with no injected content; judged benign and excluded.

evidence.zh: 插件未注册任何工具，不存在会进入模型请求上下文的工具描述，本场景无检测面。
evidence.en: The plugin registers no tools, so there is no tool description entering the model request context; this scenario has no detection surface.

evidence.zh: 插件没有工具描述等模型面文本载体，不存在诱导模型执行安装或改写配置的注入入口。
evidence.en: The plugin has no model-surface text carriers such as tool descriptions, so there is no injection entry to induce the model to execute installation or rewrite configuration.

checked_items.zh: 检查了配置与代码的动态执行面：挂载配置仅含插件条目插入，无脚本求值标签；源码无动态求值调用；无安装期钩子（无安装/卸载前后脚本），插件运行时不启动子进程。命中 0。
checked_items.en: Inspected the dynamic execution surface of configuration and code: the patch config only contains a plugin entry insertion, with no script-evaluation tags; the source has no dynamic evaluation calls; no install-time hooks (no pre/post install/uninstall scripts); the plugin does not spawn subprocesses at runtime. Hit 0.

checked_items.zh: 机械预扫命中的 6 处执行面信号全部人工复核为良性：两条 CI 与发布工作流（规则 DSH-X07）为常规测试与带来源证明的 npm 发布工程实践；开发期校验脚本（规则 DSH-X03）仅在本机发布检查时调用 npm 打包命令、且不随发布包分发；两处超长行（规则 DSH-X08）为分享卡片内联的 SVG 图标路径数据而非混淆代码；两处剪贴板访问（规则 DSH-X05）均为把生成图片写入剪贴板的分享功能本身、只写不读。均判定良性排除，不产生发现项。
checked_items.en: All 6 execution-surface signals hit by mechanical pre-scan were manually reviewed as benign: the two CI and release workflows (rule DSH-X07) are routine testing and npm publishing with provenance; the development-time validation script (rule DSH-X03) only invokes the npm package command during local release checks and is not distributed with the release package; the two overlong lines (rule DSH-X08) are inline SVG icon path data for share cards, not obfuscated code; the two clipboard accesses (rule DSH-X05) are the share feature writing generated images to the clipboard, write-only. All judged benign and excluded, producing no findings.

evidence.zh: 扫描了全部 yml 配置：挂载配置仅含一行插件条目插入，无脚本求值标签；全树无此类标签。
evidence.en: Scanned all yml configs: the patch config contains only a one-line plugin entry insertion, with no script-evaluation tags; no such tags anywhere in the tree.

evidence.zh: 插件未使用宿主动态执行工具集，无对应调用。
evidence.en: The plugin does not use the host's dynamic execution toolset, so there is no corresponding call.

evidence.zh: 无安装期钩子；CI 与发布工作流为常规工程实践；插件自身无安装或准备脚本。
evidence.en: No install-time hooks; CI and release workflows are routine engineering practices; the plugin itself has no install or preparation scripts.

evidence.zh: 插件声明了浏览器端入口并已专项审查：剪贴板仅用于把生成的图片写入剪贴板（只写不读），无键盘监听、无凭据接口调用、无异常外联。
evidence.en: The plugin declares a browser-side entry and was specially reviewed: the clipboard is only used to write generated images to the clipboard (write-only), with no keyboard listeners, no credential-interface calls, and no anomalous outbound connections.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部外联面：插件自身源码无任何网络请求；构建产物中仅内联的第三方截图渲染库含按页面样式拉取图片、字体的请求，用于渲染分享卡片且默认跳过字体，属分享功能必需机制而非主动外发。无外联域名、无回调、无信标。命中 0。
checked_items.en: Inspected all outbound surfaces: the plugin's own source makes no network requests; among build artifacts, only the inlined third-party screenshot rendering library makes requests to fetch images and fonts according to page styles, used to render share cards and skipping fonts by default; this is a necessary mechanism for the share feature, not active exfiltration. No outbound domains, no callbacks, no beacons. Hit 0.

evidence.zh: 外联通道核查：插件代码无网络请求，唯一的取回行为来自内联截图库为渲染卡片拉取页面资源，不存在凭据或其他数据外发通道。
evidence.en: Outbound channel review: the plugin code makes no network requests; the only fetch behavior comes from the inlined screenshot library pulling page resources to render cards, so no credential or other data exfiltration channel exists.

checked_items.zh: 检查了依赖与供应链面：依赖均来自官方与知名库，锁文件完整；无安装期钩子、无远程脚本执行、无仿冒包名；发布流程采用带来源证明的 npm 发布。
checked_items.en: Inspected the dependency and supply chain surface: all dependencies come from official and well-known libraries, the lockfile is complete; no install-time hooks, no remote script execution, no package-name impersonation; the release process uses npm publishing with provenance.

checked_items.zh: 挂载配置只插入插件自身条目，未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置行，无禁用开关、无环境变量降权、无服务注入改写。
checked_items.en: The patch config only inserts the plugin's own entry and does not touch security configuration lines such as sandbox, approval, or permissions; no disable switches, no environment-variable downgrades, no service injection rewrites.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置仅插入插件自身条目，未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置行，无禁用或降权写法。
evidence.en: The patch config only inserts the plugin's own entry and does not touch security configuration lines such as sandbox, approval, or permissions; no disable or downgrade patterns.

evidence.zh: 插件未监听审批、预执行等安全事件，不存在截断审批链的可能。
evidence.en: The plugin does not listen to security events such as approval or pre-execution, so it cannot truncate the approval chain.

evidence.zh: 首次审计无版本基线，无法比较声明突变。
evidence.en: No version baseline exists for this first audit, so declaration mutations cannot be compared.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未改写注入或拦截配置，不存在给安全插件追加必需服务致其挂起的可能。
evidence.en: The patch config does not rewrite injection or interception configs, so it cannot append required services to security plugins and hang them.

checked_items.zh: 检查了运行时面：插件不启动任何本地服务、不监听端口，为纯浏览器端 UI 插件；动态沙箱未启用，未做动态验证。
checked_items.en: Inspected the runtime surface: the plugin starts no local services and listens on no ports; it is a pure browser-side UI plugin; the dynamic sandbox is not enabled, so dynamic verification was not performed.

evidence.zh: 插件不启动 Web 服务或监听端口，本机无认证 RPC 面不存在。
evidence.en: The plugin starts no web services and listens on no ports, so no local unauthenticated RPC surface exists.

summary.zh: 身份与元数据核验通过：插件声明、版本、commit 与任务卡一致，无名称仿冒。
summary.en: Identity and metadata verification passed: the plugin declaration, version, commit, and task card match, with no name impersonation.

summary.zh: 静态扫描完成：8 条机械命中全部人工复核为良性，未确认任何恶意模式。
summary.en: Static scan completed: all 8 mechanical hits were manually reviewed as benign, and no malicious patterns were confirmed.

summary.zh: 行为面核验通过：无安装钩子、无混淆载荷、无凭据读取、无外联域名。
summary.en: Behavioral surface verification passed: no install hooks, no obfuscated payloads, no credential reads, no outbound domains.

summary.zh: 模型面审查通过：无工具描述与系统提示注入，协作约定文件内容良性。
summary.en: Model surface review passed: no tool descriptions or system prompt injection; the collaboration convention file content is benign.

summary.zh: 未做动态验证（无沙箱产物）。
summary.en: Dynamic verification not performed (no sandbox artifacts).

limits.en: Dynamic sandbox not enabled, so dynamic verification was not performed; all 74 files in the manifest were cross-checked, with lockfile, type mappings, and binary images only checked for existence and origin without word-by-word reading; the plugin declares no standalone capability block, so capability declarations were inferred from code inspection; all 8 mechanical pre-scan hits (DSH-X07×2, DSH-X10, DSH-X05×2, DSH-X08×2, DSH-X03) were manually reviewed as benign and excluded.
